problem:
The row echelon form matrix $B$ is given below. What are the pivot columns of $B?$

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

feedback.problem:
The row echelon form matrix $M$ is given below. What are the pivot columns of $M?$

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}0 & -5 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $M$ has $2$ pivots in the $2$nd and $3$rd columns:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}0 & -5 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
